# Prohelion Documentation

> Official technical documentation for Prohelion's Profinity CAN bus management software, Battery Management Systems, Motor Controllers, Solar Charge Controllers, and Solar Car Racing electronics.

## Profinity Software

- [Profinity V2.3 Overview](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/index.html): Current release (Early Adopter — contact Prohelion at contact@prohelion.com for access). Modern CAN bus management platform connecting CAN bus based solutions to AI, Cloud, APIs and Big Data technologies.
- [Quick Start Guide](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Getting_Started/Quick_Start.html): Install Profinity, load an example profile, replay CAN logs, and edit your first dashboard.
- [Windows Installation](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Installation/Windows_Installation.html): Install Profinity on Windows using the setup wizard.
- [Managing Users](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Administration/Manage_Users.html): Administration guide for user accounts and access.
- [Extending Profinity](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Extending_Profinity/index.html): APIs, components, custom components, dashboards, hosting, MCP server, scripting and theming for building on Profinity.
- [How To Guides](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/How_To_Guides/index.html): Task-focused guides covering dashboards, CAN bus, data logging, scripting and more.
- [Release Notes](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_2.3/Release_Notes/index.html): Version history and changelog for Profinity V2.
- [Profinity V1 (Retired)](https://docs.prohelion.com/Profinity_Software/Profinity_Version_1/index.html): Documentation for the retired first-generation Profinity server.

## Battery Management Systems

- [Battery Management Systems Overview](https://docs.prohelion.com/Battery_Management_Systems/index.html): Overview of Prohelion's BMS product line.
- [BMS D1000 Gen2](https://docs.prohelion.com/Battery_Management_Systems/Prohelion_BMS_D1000_Gen2/index.html): User manual for the Prohelion Battery Management System (BMS) D1000 Gen2.
- [BMS D1000 Gen1](https://docs.prohelion.com/Battery_Management_Systems/Prohelion_BMS_D1000_Gen1/index.html): User manual for the Prohelion Battery Management System (BMS) D1000 Gen1.
- [BMS M48 Gen1](https://docs.prohelion.com/Battery_Management_Systems/Prohelion_BMS_M48_Gen1/index.html): User manual for the Prohelion Battery Management Unit (BMU) M48 Gen1.

## Motor Controllers

- [Motor Controllers Overview](https://docs.prohelion.com/Motor_Controllers/index.html): Overview of Prohelion's WaveSculptor motor controller range.
- [WaveSculptor22 User Manual](https://docs.prohelion.com/Motor_Controllers/WaveSculptor22/User_Manual/index.html): User manual for the WaveSculptor22 motor controller.
- [WaveSculptor200 User Manual](https://docs.prohelion.com/Motor_Controllers/WaveSculptor200/User_Manual/index.html): User manual for the WaveSculptor200 motor controller.

## Solar Charge Controllers

- [Solar Charge Controllers by Elmar](https://docs.prohelion.com/Solar_Charge_Controllers/index.html): Documentation for the Elmar range of solar MPPT charge controllers distributed by Prohelion.

## Solar Car Racing

- [Solar Car Racing Solutions](https://docs.prohelion.com/Solar_Car_Racing/index.html): Products and solutions for solar car racing teams, including CAN/Ethernet bridges, EV driver controls, and open source software used in competitions such as the World Solar Challenge, American Solar Challenge, and Formula Sun Grand Prix.
